body:
33 million word puzzles. that is the actual price fans paid to see a tracklist.

september 2023: to unlock the vault-track titles on 1989 (taylor’s version), the rollout ran a scavenger hunt with google. searching her name spilled a blue vault across the results page, and every puzzle a fan solved moved one shared counter. the target was 33 million.

the fandom cleared it in under a day. the puzzle itself crashed at one point under the weight of everyone trying. the titles unlocked anyway.

easter-egg culture as actual infrastructure — and that is one case file out of the thirty inside The Clue Web.

longlivets.com/?lens=easter-eggs&utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=thread-clue-web

📷 the eras tour in são paulo, november 2023, mid-1989 (taylor's version) rollout — buda mendes/tas23/getty images for tas rights management. swipe for the clue web entry.
why: Calendar slot 2026-08-18 23:00Z IG, thread:easter-eggs:single-best-item (August’s Clue Web angle per the ledger) — one case file told whole, with the thread as the byline in the last line rather than the subject. Media is the real Clue Web screenshot from PR #1903, rung 1. Source: the "The Google vault puzzles" easter-egg entry in theories.generated.ts, confidence: official, outcome: confirmed (sourced Wikipedia, 1989 (Taylor’s Version)) — 33 million Google word puzzles solved collectively to reveal the vault titles, the blue vault spilling across her search results, the fandom clearing the target in under a day, and the puzzle crashing under the load. "thirty inside The Clue Web" is the 0/30 eggs count visible on the screenshot. DEPLOY DEPENDENCY: needs #1903 deployed. | 2026-08-12 Taylor-photo standard (issue #2031, Joey directive): attached a real credited photograph of Taylor from the repo corpus (apps/web/lib/longlive/lenses.ts), rehosted under /social/library/photos/. Campaign renamed to a STORY-UNIQUE value: findPostedDuplicate treats same platform+campaign as an already-posted duplicate, so the old thematic bucket campaigns (heartbeat:*) would have false-skipped every post in a bucket after its first one landed. Upgraded to a carousel: Taylor photo as the grid tile, the product screenshot as slide 2. | 2026-08-15 third-party image policy (docs/decisions.md): the Getty-sourced photo tile (taylor-eras-midnights-sao-paulo-2023.jpg) was removed from the library and dropped from this item's media; it now runs on the Clue Web screenshot alone, so mediaKind moved from "photo" to "site-screen" and the now-inapplicable mediaCredit/mediaSource were removed with it.
